en.c5d: computed from sleep, HRV, RHR, stress & recent load
en.rec: Lights out 23:33, up at 06:25 — 6h 44m asleep inside 6h 52m in bed, 98% efficiency and only 8 minutes awake. Short night, but the composition is the best of the window: 101 minutes of deep sleep, 25% of the night, tying Sunday's 101 for the window high and standing well above the 61 and 65 of the two nights before it. Deep has now run 82, 73, 93, 101, 61, 65, 101 across the seven nights — no sign of the thin-deep stretch that showed up two weeks ago. REM paid for the length: 85 minutes is the window low, down from 98 and 90, and that is what a 6h 44m night takes out first. Score 81, one under last night. The autonomics are the one thing that has drifted. HRV came in at 34 — a point up on last night's 33, but four under the 38 seven-night average, and 33 and 34 are the lowest consecutive pair on the chart. The window has been oddly split: 42, 42, then 34, 37, 42, then 33, 34. RHR has not followed it down at all — 53 this morning, the window low, and it has sat in a 53–55 band all seven nights. Morning stress reads 19 and the day is only a few hours old. Readiness 79, moderate: good sleep architecture and a clean RHR, held back by two soft HRV nights. Tracking is now complete — seven consecutive recorded nights, no gaps left on the chart. Timing is the loose thread. Bedtime has wandered from 21:30 on Saturday to 23:33 last night, and duration with it: 9h 58m, then 7h 50m, 7h 14m, 7h 47m, 6h 44m. Two short nights in the last three. If tonight lands before 23:00, the HRV dip most likely closes on its own.

hr.c5d: izračunato iz sna, HRV-a, RHR-a, stresa i opterećenja
hr.rec: Gašenje svjetla u 23:33, ustajanje u 06:25 — 6h 44m sna unutar 6h 52m u krevetu, 98% učinkovitosti i samo 8 minuta budnosti. Kratka noć, ali sastav je najbolji u prozoru: 101 minuta dubokog sna, 25% noći, izjednačeno s nedjeljnih 101 kao vrhunac prozora i znatno iznad 61 i 65 iz dvije prethodne noći. Duboki san kroz sedam noći ide 82, 73, 93, 101, 61, 65, 101 — nema traga onom nizu tankog dubokog sna otprije dva tjedna. REM je platio kraću noć: 85 minuta je minimum prozora, naspram 98 i 90, a upravo to prvo strada na noći od 6h 44m. Ocjena 81, jedna niže od prethodne noći. Autonomika je jedino što je odlutalo. HRV je 34 — bod više od sinoćnjih 33, ali četiri ispod sedmodnevnog prosjeka od 38, a 33 i 34 najniži su uzastopni par na grafu. Prozor je čudno podijeljen: 42, 42, pa 34, 37, 42, pa 33, 34. RHR ga uopće nije slijedio prema dolje — 53 jutros, minimum prozora, i cijelih sedam noći drži se u rasponu 53–55. Jutarnji stres pokazuje 19, a dan je star tek nekoliko sati. Spremnost 79, umjerena: dobra arhitektura sna i čist RHR, koje koče dvije mlake HRV noći. Praćenje je sad potpuno — sedam uzastopnih zabilježenih noći, bez rupa na grafu. Labava nit je raspored. Odlazak na spavanje odlutao je s 21:30 u subotu na 23:33 sinoć, a trajanje za njim: 9h 58m, pa 7h 50m, 7h 14m, 7h 47m, 6h 44m. Dvije kratke noći u zadnje tri. Ako večeras legneš prije 23:00, HRV pad će se najvjerojatnije sam zatvoriti.
